finding.text: The shots do not show the change. They were taken at `monorepo.localhost`, which serves the main tree (`michael/dev`), and the work is still unmerged on `worktree/page-context-asks` (3fab1f0af). layout.json has 6 bands at every width (title, md, md, the nav card, h2 + md "Run it yourself"), with no band for the new "On any object" h2, its card or the weighted previews, and no open-work line. So nothing visual about #6 or #7 is proven yet: re-shoot from the worktree or after the merge (requirement 2, "Layout-check 400/1200/1920/3440 for any page change").

Requirement 2 asks for "smoke clean", and neither STATE.md nor task.jsonl shows a smoke run. The probes it does cite (horizontal scroll, the line on /framework/ai/) are described in words, with no output or shot saved in the task folder.

`PageWeight.apply` moves every card to the end of the box (`box.el.append(el)`). On a list that uses `group`, the `h4.page-previews-group` headings stay at the top and the cards lose their groups (Previews.js `list`). The core/Page demo has no groups, so it only bites a grouped list.

The open-work line only updates when someone runs `node Server/page-ai-cost.mjs --work` by hand. STATE.md says so honestly (blocked on the Servex tick and its restart), so #6 is really "partly", not "done" as asks.md now says.

Ask #6 also says "defines pages vs embedded cards". Neither STATE.md nor the asks.md update mentions it. It was not in the old "Open" line, so it is probably covered elsewhere, but it is not ticked with proof.
Existing page, not from this diff: at 1200 the Page tab bar wraps to 3 rows (layout.json `tab_rows 3`), and at 400 the drawer rail buttons wrap to 3.2 lines.
